title: SiteShrimp Photo Entry — Building Defects (Highrise) variant
description: Variant for high-rise residential / mixed-use defect inspections — condos, apartments, towers. Adds vertical-zone and unit-identification fields that drive routing to property-management vs main-contractor responsibility, and identify which common-area scope applies for FM handover.

block_or_tower.description: Block or tower identifier (e.g. 'Block A', 'Tower 3'). Free text — projects use varied conventions.

unit_no.description: Unit / stack identifier (e.g. '#08-12'). Empty for common-area defects.

vertical_zone.description: Which vertical zone the defect sits in. Drives the responsibility split between management corp / contractor / unit owner.
